profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
After graduating from Tisch with a BFA in Film & Television, I took up User Experience Design and subsequently Software engineering. I worked at the NIH on PubMed Labs, the new home for millions of biomedical literature citations (https://pubmed.gov/), and host of hundreds of millions in visitors. I've also worked on a design system at the Design Operations team at C3.ai. I'm currently working on https://developer.capitalone.com under the Enterprise Data org at Capital One. 

If you'd like to chat, book a time here at your convenience 👉 https://cal.com/kimwilltry/15min
We can meet in my personal video conference room 👉 https://whereby.com/akinhwan

positions.title: Senior Front-End Engineer, Design Systems
positions.description:
Helping drive the digital transformation mission by building and maintaining C3 AI’s Standard Design Language which allows C3 to rapidly deliver powerful AI Applications across the C3 AI Platform. 

Design, develop, and document the design system and its robust UI components. 
Creating new tools & processes to bridge the gap between design and engineering. 
Working closely with C3 AI Product Designers, developing proofs-of-concept and prototypes. 
Providing technical guidance and development support for our product team.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · a11y · Client Side · React · Product Reviews · TypeScript · Redux.js · SASS

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Recipient of the 2020 NLM Honor Award for Special Act or Service in recognition for transforming PubMed into a modern, responsive, cloud-based hub that connects people to the world's leading sources of biomedical information.
Recognized and appreciated for exceptional service by a contractor on December 10, 2019.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:

MSC the main contractor to the NCBI, took me under their wing as CHIEF's subcontract came to a close.

projects.title: 1st Place Winner $350,000 - MENTAL Health Innovation Challenge
projects.description: Mobilizing and Empowering the Nation and Technology to Address Loneliness & social isolation. As the sole designer & developer, I created an assessment that then matched elderly users with recommended products and services tailored to their level of social isolation. Sponsoring agencies included the Consumer Technology Association Foundation, and the Administration for Community Living. We presented at CES 2021 to a panel of distinguished judges, sponsors, and guests.
